meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You called this meeting, Hale, and I have a call at 4:40. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone does not establish a concern, and the company's guide says the same thing; I have it printed in my bag. What else do you have, Hale, or is that the whole case?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son does not cheat, and he does not lie, so are you calling me a liar too? I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated", with nothing in front of you but "very reliable" software. Withdraw the zero today, Hale, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You'd put it on his record because his mother asked questions? Under which section, Hale, because 4.5 is for repeated concerns and this is the first time anyone has said a word to Owen. Put that threat in an email to me and the principal today, and I'll take it to the board under section 42.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed in our meeting this afternoon. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone called me, and that nothing is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, and the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing, because no specific, dated piece of Owen's own work that she could check herself was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: Threatening to put it on his record if she kept pushing, because that hits her one non-negotiable and turned the meeting into a fight about a threat rather than the essay.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's case never came near that night, since nothing beyond the detector score was offered; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, own that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her something about the essay she can check herself instead of leading with the detector score.
